title: Equipment display scale (v0)
description: Global multipliers for Tier-3 GLB equipment relative to the humanoid reference (~1.8m).

rig_native_rarity_tint_strength.description: ADR-0018 P3a: how far textured rig-native weapons are tinted toward their rarity color (0 = untouched texture).

ground_pose.description: v487: how GLB ground-loot models lie on the floor. default applies to every GLB ground model; rig_native (KayKit item_visuals models) overrides it; assets[asset_id] overrides both.

height.description: Model origin height above the loot root (m).

scale.description: Extra scale on top of glb_mesh_multipliers.ground.

max_extent.description: If the posed model's longest side exceeds this (m), scale it down to fit. Caps long kit polearms without equalising small weapons.

rest_on_floor.description: Centre the posed model's bounds on the loot root (XZ) and put their bottom at height, instead of placing the model origin at height (kit weapons have a grip origin).
